takeaway: After a week of the radar's own readings, Cloudflare's security-audit skill is up 39% (32,421 to 45,182 stars) and holds about 2,500 a day, now #2 on GitHub's weekly trending. morluto/rea is slowing for a fifth day.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill: +39% in a week
findings.text: Measured from 32,421 stars on Oct 19 to 45,182 on Oct 25, about 2,500 a day for four days. The weekly trending page shows +12,680. No announcement or merged commit explains it.

findings.heading: morluto/rea keeps slowing
findings.text: Its measured daily gain fell five days running, from 9,917 to 5,570 stars. It stays flagged and discounted.

findings.heading: Platform vendors' agent toolkits are trending
findings.text: aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws (official AWS skills, MCP servers and plugins for coding agents) and google-gemini/gemini-cli (108,233 stars; releases on Oct 20) both appear on GitHub trending.

findings.heading: Agent infrastructure leads commercial growth
findings.text: Exa reports over $100M ARR growing about 10x a year; Daytona grew 25x from January to September; Blacksmith 17x since January. All three were read from search results.

findings.heading: Horizon3's $100M ARR is confirmed
findings.text: The Oct 20 release is titled 'Horizon3 Surpasses $100 Million ARR with 120%+ Growth'. Earlier 'nearing $100M' wording came from older funding coverage.

caveats: Several apps still rank on gains stated up to six days ago; the report's new measured-movers table shows them growing modestly or off trending.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; news sites cannot be opened from the cloud environment.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable, and GitHub trending pages list only 10 to 21 repos.
The first forecast matures tomorrow; until then the ranking is untested.
